scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
If you fought Morocc
and collected
Hero Tokens,
I can exchange them with a special ring for you.
Do you want to take a look at my ring?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
如果您对抗梦罗克时收集到了英雄代币，可以来我这里兑换一枚特别的戒指。
要看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Your pack has a lot of items,
Please come again after arrange it!
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
您携带的物品太多了，请整理好物品栏再来吧！

scripts.text: Ring description
scripts.translation: 戒指说明

scripts.text: Exchange with the ring.
scripts.translation: 兑换戒指

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
This Hero Ring
may not
look
impressive,
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
这枚勇士之戒看起来也许并不起眼...

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
but take it to
Expert Enchanter Byrnes,
and he can Enchant
all 4 sockets in it
and bring out
its latent abilities.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
但只要交给附魔专家伯恩斯，他就能为它的全部4个插槽附魔，激发戒指潜藏的力量。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring
can aid you
in subjugating
Morocc.
Any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
勇士之戒能助您讨伐梦罗克。
还有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text:
- Hero Ring -
^006400A ring made for warriors^000000
^006400on the quest to defeat Morocc..^000000
^006400When Enchanted,^000000
^006400it lends its owner^000000
^006400the power to confront Morocc.^000000
^006400Clas: Accessory/DEF: 0^000000
^006400Weight: 20/Required Level: 160^000000
^006400Slot: 0/Equip To: All Jobs^000000

[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring requires
30 Hero Tokens
for the exchange.
Do you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
兑换一枚勇士之戒需要30个英雄代币。
您要兑换吗？

scripts.text: Previous menu.
scripts.translation: 返回上一级菜单

scripts.text: Exchange 30 Hero Tokens.
scripts.translation: 用30个英雄代币兑换

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Think
again.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
再考虑一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
^006400Hero Token^000000
is given to
those who bravely fought Morocc.
You don't have
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000,
and therefore I can't assist you.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
^006400英雄代币^000000是对勇敢对抗梦罗克之人的奖励。
您没有凑齐30个^006400英雄代币^000000，我没法为您兑换。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
I'll exchange
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000
with 1 ^006400Hero Ring^000000.
Anything else?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
这就用您的30个^006400英雄代币^000000兑换1枚^006400勇士之戒^000000。
还有其他需要吗？

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
One day
you'll find yourself
in need of Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代币兑换员]
总有一天，您会需要这枚勇士之戒的。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Have you heard of Hero Ring? Only true heroes deserve to possess that magnificent ring, and I've been waiting for one.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您听说过勇士之戒吗？
只有真正的英雄才配拥有那枚华丽的戒指，我一直在等待这样的英雄。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Enchant Hero Ring.
scripts.translation: 附魔勇士之戒

scripts.text: Reset Enchantments on Hero Ring.
scripts.translation: 重置勇士之戒的附魔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
I can Enchant only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to Enchant?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
我只能为已装备的戒指附魔。
您想为哪一枚戒指附魔？

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左侧戒指

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右侧戒指

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip the Hero Ring that you want to enchant.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
请先装备您想附魔的勇士之戒。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't Enchant anything else.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
请装备您的勇士之戒，我只能为这种戒指附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
A fully enchanted Hero Ring cannot be enchanted any further.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
完全附魔的勇士之戒无法再进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot 4?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您想为第4个插槽附加哪种能力？

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot 3?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您想为第3个插槽附加哪种能力？

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot 1?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您想为第1个插槽附加哪种能力？

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot 2?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您想为第2个插槽附加哪种能力？

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Enchantment completed!
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
附魔完成！

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
To reset Enchantments on your Hero Ring, I need 3 Hero Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
要重置勇士之戒的附魔，我需要3个英雄代币。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的英雄代币不够，无法重置勇士之戒的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
I can reset only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to reset?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
我只能重置已装备戒指的附魔。
您想重置哪一枚？

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左侧戒指

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右侧戒指

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You first have to equip the item to reset its Enchantment status.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您必须先装备该物品，才能重置其附魔状态。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't reset anything else.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
请装备您的勇士之戒，我只能重置这种戒指的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的英雄代币不够，无法重置勇士之戒的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Your Hero Ring is currently in a state without enchantment.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的勇士之戒还没有附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Initialization completed.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
附魔已重置。
